run_method: Unmodified Release binaries in a hidden native Windows console; process lifetime includes startup and output.
pair_method: Warmup followed by five measured repetitions in rotating variant order. No concurrent model, build or plotting workload during timing.
duration_note: The fixture stores the requested duration. GRAMM selects the actual integration target from meteorological class and wind; neutral 3600-second inputs finish at the built-in 600-second target. Fixed-order fidelity records verify the target and completion.
